steps.change: Reuse known edition, intent, answers and permitted sources. Give one brief first-run welcome or evidence-based return greeting in the person's language, without replaying onboarding. The compact core routes to needed phase instructions; complete recovery needs no second command.

Keep seen/started/completed editions distinct. Compare actual relevant revisions; preserve answers, choices and one readable checkpoint. Reconcile unknown outcomes/concurrent changes before dependent work. Optionally check the active site edition once per real entry/return; user-selected coherent updates reuse prior work.
Review the agreed working area narrowly, show source-bound project candidates for selection, then adapt the optional layout and accompany only approved adoption.

steps.relevance: reusable personal/work context chosen by the person
steps.change: Offer selected CV/professional-page/notes first, show a short reviewable summary, then ask only individually relevant gaps; preserve manual and skip paths.

steps.relevance: a real task needs available context
steps.change: Select the minimum relevant context and verify one source detail and one applicable preference.

steps.relevance: chosen-journey completion or a later suitable task, with suggestions permitted
steps.change: Offer only a concretely relevant optional skill or respond to a request; no default two-skill closing bundle, forced preference question or installation grant. Respect existing choices and suggestion restrictions.

steps.relevance: chosen personal/work context or project overview has a material missing fact after source/answer reuse
steps.change: Use only the individually needed added questions; preserve why/effect/fallback, five states, honest counts and no repeat of known facts.

steps.relevance: the person chooses a task using selected incoming materials or an inbox; never a background or mandatory onboarding step
steps.change: Review permitted incoming material with provenance, propose one canonical home and useful extraction, distinguish routing from knowledge confirmation, apply only exact approved supported actions or provide an unapplied manual plan, and resume only relevant new/changed/pending material without repeated questions.

steps.relevance: chosen-scope finish, pending decision or pause
steps.change: Close with the actual result and necessary pending step. Support independent use; offer at most one concretely useful unconfigured capability, preserving completed equivalents, declines and deferrals. No generic repeat-Kit invitation. Stop means no reads/offers; ordinary tasks do not restart setup.
